title: Array reduce sum
code: const sum = (xs) => xs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);

title: Debounce
code: const debounce = (fn, ms) => { let t; return (...a) => { clearTimeout(t); t = setTimeout(() => fn(...a), ms); }; };

title: Promise all map
code: const fetchAll = async (urls) => Promise.all(urls.map((u) => fetch(u).then((r) => r.json())));

title: Group by key
code: const groupBy = (xs, k) => xs.reduce((acc, x) => ({ ...acc, [x[k]]: [...(acc[x[k]] ?? []), x] }), {});

title: Memoize
code: const memo = (fn) => { const c = new Map(); return (k) => c.has(k) ? c.get(k) : (c.set(k, fn(k)), c.get(k)); };

title: Range
code: const range = (n) => Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => i);

title: Pipe
code: const pipe = (...fns) => (x) => fns.reduce((v, f) => f(v), x);
